terms.title: Welcome, {{name}}! First, read the terms
terms.text: Once you accept, you'll fill in your passport name and a close contact, and your panel opens.
terms.label: Terms and conditions
terms.accept: I've read and accept Scorize's terms and conditions.

profile.title: Complete a few essential details
profile.text: These are needed for university and embassy forms. Your panel opens once they're saved.
profile.latin: In English letters, as in your passport.
profile.mobile: Enter a mobile number starting with 09, 11 digits.
profile.error: Not saved. Check the values and try again.

survey.title: Before you continue, tell us what you think
survey.text: To open your panel, answer {{n}} short surveys about your supervisors. Under a minute.
survey.question: Over the past month, how satisfied were you with {{name}}'s follow-up?

inactive.title: Your contract has ended
inactive.text: The applicant panel is closed, but your email logins are still here.
inactive.emailsText: The emails we created for your applications. We suggest changing the password.
inactive.next: We're here for your next degree too
inactive.nextText: Share your experience with friends, or book a consultation for your PhD.
inactive.consult: Book a consultation for your next degree

nps.title: Just a few seconds of your time
nps.text: For your time, {{amount}} toman is added to your credit.
nps.question: From 1 to 10, how likely are you to recommend Scorize?
nps.thanks: Thanks! {{amount}} toman was added to your credit.
